recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a single dead pixel snuffing out an entire screen
silver rails crossing where they shouldn't near toledo
satellite fleets changing hands under autumn constellations
luxury liners anchored as fuel prices spike offshore
first gas flame in tanzania in over ten years
clear nine-degree night settling over san francisco

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Dodge falling dead-LED fragments before they cascade and kill your whole display — one faulty pixel triggers a chain blackout across the screen.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag left/right between three vertical lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: survive thirty seconds without a blackout to trigger a full-screen restore flash
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fragments fall faster and split into smaller pixels that block lanes
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: CRT phosphor green on deep autumn indigo

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap fuel-gauge beats to keep a stranded cruise ship's engines idling — rhythm timing against a draining tank before the anchor wins.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap pulsing gauge nodes along a curved fuel arc
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nail the final beat to watch the anchor lift for one satisfying frame
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: beat windows shrink as the fuel meter drops toward empty
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor ocean dusk with amber gauge glow

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw agent routes from a phone shortcut through GitHub Actions nodes without crossing wires — spin up pipelines from your thumb during a quiet repo week.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace paths, lift finger to commit route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: complete a three-agent pipeline in under forty-five seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: new action nodes appear mid-round forcing reroutes through tighter gaps
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe on fog-gray SF night sky

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick gas-flame tokens into matching borehole slots before Tanzania's discovery celebration accelerates — one-screen sorting against rising pressure.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to flick flame tokens toward colored well slots
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: slot four perfect flames in a row for a celebratory flare burst
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: decoy cold tokens bounce back and clutter the drilling pad
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout savanna dusk with orange flame accents
